knowledgeGraph.title: AI coding assistants
knowledgeGraph.description: Software engineering tools that generate, review and refactor code

organic.title: Developer Survey 2025: AI results
organic.snippet: AI: 84% of professional developers are using or planning to use AI coding tools, up from 61% last year. The survey gathered responses from 49,000 developers.

organic.title: Research: quantifying GitHub Copilot's impact on developer productivity and happiness
organic.snippet: In controlled studies, developers accepted just over 30% of Copilot's code suggestions, while perception of productivity doubled.

organic.title: Agentic Coding Benchmarks: A Systematic Evaluation of 12 Systems
organic.snippet: We evaluate 12 agentic coding systems on 1,040 repository-level tasks. The best system completes 41% of tasks end-to-end without human intervention.

organic.title: Claude Code overview - Anthropic docs
organic.snippet: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that runs in your terminal. It reads and edits files, runs commands, and works with a 200,000 token context window.

organic.title: Enterprise adoption of coding agents rose to 38%
organic.snippet: A survey of 400 large employers found adoption of AI coding agents reached 38% this year, up from 21% a year earlier. Budgets are shifting from pilot to line-item.

organic.title: Coding agents reshape developer tooling budgets
organic.snippet: Tooling spend on coding agents grew to $1.2B annually, with most seats sold on annual contracts averaging $480 per developer per month.

organic.title: AI Act - regulatory framework
organic.snippet: High-risk AI system obligations under the AI Act apply from 2 August 2026. AI systems used in recruitment and worker management are classified as high-risk.

organic.title: How teams are reviewing agent-generated code
organic.snippet: Developers reported trusting AI suggestions for boilerplate far more than for security-sensitive changes.

organic.title: Coding agent pricing comparison 2026
organic.snippet: Gartner tracked 9 coding assistant products and found median list pricing of $40 per seat per month.

organic.title: Retrieval-augmented generation for code search
organic.snippet: RAG over code repositories improves retrieval precision by 22% versus BM25 baselines on cross-file questions.
